question: For $\vec{a}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}$, evaluate $-3\vec{a}$.
explanation:
Step 1: When a vector is multiplied by a scalar, each component of the vector is multiplied by that scalar.
Step 2: Substitute $\vec{a}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k}$ into $-3\vec{a}$.
Step 3: Thus, $-3\vec{a}=-3(2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k})$.
Step 4: Multiplying the components gives $-6\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-3\hat{k}$.
Final Answer: $-3\vec{a}=-6\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-3\hat{k}$.
